ITEM 1 | Dark brown, charred-looking piece with crisp, blackened edges and a dry, ridged surface; roughly 6 cm long by 4 cm wide, irregular chunky shape with a thick end, sitting at the upper right of the plate and partly overlapping a pale, translucent yellowish curled piece with a small red fleck | 45
ITEM 2 | Pale yellowish-translucent curled sliver, glossy and slightly moist, about 4 cm long and thin (under 1 cm), lying against the dark charred piece at upper right | 8
ITEM 3 | Light pinkish-tan piece with a fibrous, layered grain and a few whitish fatty streaks, slightly glossy, dry-looking edges, roughly 5 cm long by 2.5 cm wide and about 1.5 cm thick, lying at the lower left of the plate | 30
ITEM 4 | Brown piece with a seared, browned outer surface and a pale creamy-white edge on one side, somewhat dense, about 4 cm by 3 cm and about 1.5 cm thick, lying at the bottom center of the plate | 25
